def factor_corr_ret_voldev_zscore(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    daily_ret = df_copy['close'].pct_change()
    vol_mean = df_copy['volume'].rolling(20, min_periods=5).mean()
    vol_dev = df_copy['volume'] / vol_mean - 1.0
    vol_dev_mean = vol_dev.rolling(30, min_periods=20).mean()
    vol_dev_std = vol_dev.rolling(30, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    vol_dev_z = (vol_dev - vol_dev_mean) / vol_dev_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    corr = daily_ret.rolling(30, min_periods=20).corr(vol_dev_z)
    factor = corr.fillna(0.0)
    df_copy['factor_corr_ret_voldev_zscore'] = factor
    return df_copy['factor_corr_ret_voldev_zscore']
description: Primary mechanism from pv_coherence_002: rolling correlation between signed daily returns and volume deviation captures persistent directional volume confirmation. Borrowed from secondary parent the lightweight idea of robust outlier handling for volume deviation, implemented as a rolling z-score instead of raw relative deviation. This reduces the influence of extreme volume spikes on the correlation while preserving the continuous raw signal. No cross-sectional transform is used to retain the parent set's raw payoff evidence. Parent strength target is stable RankICIR and long-short Sharpe; bottleneck targeted is improving IC/ICIR through cleaner volume surprise measurement.
